Subject: Question: log retention and CAIQ evidence for HIPAA workflow

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. As we move toward procurement sign-off, our security team needs clarity on a couple of points related to inference logs for HIPAA-covered workloads: 1) Maximum retention window for tenant-level debug logs (server-side traces, not customer transcripts); 2) Can Redwood provide scoped, time-boxed log escrow snapshots for legal/forensics holds and what form does the evidence take (hashes, manifests, certs)? 3) Do you have a filled SIG/CAIQ with specific answers about log deletion and proof-of-delete?

If you can point to artifacts (sample manifests, a CAIQ export, or a short playbook) that would accelerate our review. Ideally we need an answer and artifacts by Tue EOD PT for our next security call.

Appreciate it — Rebecca
Rebecca Li
CISO, Astra Health
rebecca.li@astra.health

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>

Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 08:02:37 -0800
Subject: Re: Question: log retention and CAIQ evidence for HIPAA workflow

Hi Rebecca — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Neha (Security) and Stephanie (Customer Ops) to prepare a scoped packet. Quick notes while they assemble: 1) Default tenant "ephemeral debug" traces are 30 days TTL for hosted customers, configurable in Dedicated/Private; 2) We can produce time-boxed escrow snapshots (S3 tar + manifest + SHA256 checksums) for a bounded window — retention by default is 90 days for escrowed artifacts unless otherwise negotiated; 3) We maintain a CAIQ & SIG bundle and can provide a filled CAIQ with the specific control responses you asked about plus a sample proof-of-delete manifest.

Neha / Steph — can you prepare: (a) CAIQ export with highlighted entries for log deletion/proof-of-delete, (b) a short playbook (1–2 pages) describing how we produce an escrow snapshot and the verification steps (manifest, checksum, timestamped signing), and (c) a redlineable addendum language that allows Astra to request a temporary legal hold with a 30/60/90-day window? Rebecca asked for these by Tue EOD PT; if that's tight, let's aim for early Wed.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>

Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:40:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Question: log retention and CAIQ evidence for HIPAA workflow

Rishi / Steph — draft packet attached and notes inline. Summary:

- Architecture & TTLs: Hosted default ephemeral debug traces = 30d TTL; system telemetry (service-level) = 180d; tenant debug and detailed inference server traces are written to an encrypted object store with lifecycle policies. For Dedicated/Private we can set a customer-configurable TTL down to 7 days or extend to 365+ under contract.

- Escrow Snapshot Process: We produce a read-only S3 snapshot containing only selected namespaces (tenant id, time-range) exported as compressed archive. Each archive includes: manifest.csv (object path,size,mtime), sha256sum.txt (checksums), and a signed manifest.pdf (timestamped, signed by Redwood Compliance). We retain a KMS-wrapped key record in our control plane for audit.

- Proof-of-delete: For deletions we provide (1) deletion manifest with tombstone markers and deletion timestamps, (2) GPG-signed deletion-cert.pdf (signed by Compliance), and (3) option to run a small re-hydration test for a narrow timebox to verify restoration and subsequent re-delete.

- SIG/CAIQ: Attached is the filled CAIQ excerpt (sheet "Logging & Retention") and a separate PDF that maps our control responses to Astra's requirements.

- Proposed contract language (snippet):
"Astra may request an escrow snapshot for a specific tenant and time-window not to exceed 90 days per request. Redwood will produce the snapshot within 7 business days of validated request. Redwood will retain escrow artifacts for 90 days post-delivery unless the parties agree to additional retention in writing."

Attachments included: ASTRA_SIG_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx, retention-playbook-draft.pdf, log-sample-ublog-20261206.txt

Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
neha_kapoor@redwood.inference
